question: In a certain code language, COMPUTER is written as CMOQVERT, How will LANGUAGE be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**LOGIC: First 3 letters and last 3 letters are arranged according to alphabetical order and the 2 letters in middle are increased by 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ea82bd5c97415b6a0bb4a31c9208d4af49dfee9c43ef8ee84e3fd4a2b56e847.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dae80b80954094ecde8e75727ace31991a299adbf3d042f3ab8ac3516e8b8cd2.png] 

Similarly;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0adbffb2c6dfd8ed1ea70e4199bd010f6aeeb692356112af4fe90acf18b8621.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"ALNHVAEG".**
